verdict.rationale: Medusa's docs reference a dedicated Payment Module, implying an extensible payment architecture, but the evidence pack contains only the module's title with no detail on specific third-party gateway integrations (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) or explicit multi-currency charging support. Missing for 10: documented list of supported third-party payment providers, explicit multi-currency transaction support, and independent/hands-on confirmation of switching gateways.
